changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'TooltipTemplate_backup') BEGIN drop table [dbo].[TooltipTemplate_backup] END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'TooltipTemplate_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[TooltipTemplate_backup]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(500,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [Action] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [TemplateBody] [nvarchar](4000) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_TooltipTemplate] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
